newsitem.title: UK: London stocks up, FTSE 100 pushes through 3,900.
newsitem.headline: London stocks up, FTSE 100 pushes through 3,900.

text.p: UK stocks bounced higher at the start of trading on Monday, with the FTSE 100 breaking through the 3,900 level on the back of Friday's Wall Street advance.

The FTSE, up for the past three days, was up 8.4 points at 3,901.4 by 0747 GMT, after earlier rising as high as 3,904.5. Gaining stocks outweighed decliners by some five-to-four and the index was some 20 points below its record set on August 28.

Yet gains were seen capped amid persistent fears that the U.S. will raise rates later this month to cool the pace of growth, and traders were wary of drawing too much comfort from Friday's erratic New York reaction to the latest U.S. jobs data.
